"""Retain both immutable diagnostic transport failures; zero estimation calls."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import re

task = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
repo = task.parents[2]
remote = '<task>'
out = repo / 'bench/results/ownership-qualification-diagnostic-transport-failure-20261023.json'
assert not out.exists()
sha = lambda path: hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
read = lambda path: json.loads(path.read_text())

def portable(value):
    if isinstance(value, str):
        return value.replace(str(task), '<task>').replace(str(repo), '<repository>').replace(remote, '<task>')
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [portable(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {portable(k): portable(v) for k, v in value.items()}
    return value

def document(path):
    return {'bytes': path.stat().st_size, 'sha256': sha(path), 'content': read(path)}

platforms = {}
for platform, folder, plan_folder, build_name, job_log in [
    ('Darwin', task / 'sources/qualification/target/tmp/ownership-cells/qualification-diagnostics-Darwin',
     task / 'sources/qualification/target/tmp/ownership-cells', 'macos', task / 'qualification-diagnostics-Darwin.log'),
    ('Linux', task / 'linux-qualification/diagnostics-failed', task / 'linux-qualification',
     'linux', task / 'linux-qualification/diagnostics-failed-job.log')]:
    result = read(folder / 'results.json')
    assert result['status'] == 'failed' and result['native_calls_started'] == len(result['calls']) == 1
    assert result['failures'] == [{'message': 'native harness must write binary columns', 'type': 'ValueError'}]
    assert result['retries'] == 0 and result['exclusions'] == []
    call = result['calls'][0]
    assert call['arm'] == 'incumbent' and call['repeat'] == 0 and call['workers'] == 1
    assert call['cell'] == 'ownership-nonmovers-t1'
    raw = read(folder / call['target'])
    assert raw['return_code'] == 0
    columns = raw.pop('columns')
    receipts = []
    for column in columns:
        assert all(isinstance(v, str) and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{16}', v) for v in column)
        bits = b''.join(int(v, 16).to_bytes(8, 'little') for v in column)
        assert [f'{int.from_bytes(bits[i:i+8], "little"):016x}' for i in range(0, len(bits), 8)] == column
        receipts.append({'values': len(column), 'little_endian_bit_sha256': hashlib.sha256(bits).hexdigest()})
    assert len(columns) == 12 and all(len(v) == 20000 for v in columns)
    log = folder / call['log']
    assert sha(log) == call['log_sha256'] and sha(folder / call['target']) == call['result_sha256']
    assert 'NATIVE_SECONDS' not in log.read_text()
    plan = plan_folder / f'qualification-diagnostics-{platform}.json'
    assert sha(plan) == result['plan_sha256'] and len(read(plan)['schedule']) == 80
    item = {'result': document(folder / 'results.json'), 'original_plan_sha256': sha(plan),
            'raw_output': {'sha256': call['result_sha256'], 'bytes': (folder / call['target']).stat().st_size,
                           'head_without_columns': raw, 'inline_columns': receipts,
                           'bit_roundtrip': True, 'scientific_revalidation': 'pending'},
            'call_log_sha256': sha(log), 'job_log_sha256': sha(job_log),
            'observer_sha256': sha(folder / 'host' / result['host']['observations']),
            'old_harness_build': document(task / f'harness-qualification-{build_name}/build.json'),
            'process_elapsed_upper_bound_s': (call['finished_monotonic_ns'] - call['started_monotonic_ns']) / 1e9,
            'native_seconds': None, 'per_call_maxrss_bytes': None,
            'missing_fields_reason': 'The process finished before result parsing failed; the wrapper did not persist returned wait4 usage. This ordinary harness did not compile a native timer.',
            'candidate_calls': 0, 'qualification_timing_calls': 0}
    if platform == 'Darwin':
        item['outer_check'] = document(task / 'qualification-diagnostics-Darwin-check.json')
        item['charged_application_seconds'] = 2
    else:
        account = task / 'linux-qualification/diagnostics-failed-accounting.txt'
        fields = {k: v.strip() for k, v in (line.split(None, 1) for line in account.read_text().splitlines()
                                           if len(line.split(None, 1)) == 2)}
        assert fields['jobnumber'] == '8265946' and fields['failed'].split()[0] == '0' and fields['exit_status'] == '1'
        assert fields['hostname'] == 'scc-uf3.scc.bu.edu' and fields['slots'] == '28'
        assert fields['taskid'] == 'undefined' and fields['ru_wallclock'] == '34'
        item.update(accounting={'raw_sha256': sha(account), 'fields': fields},
                    charged_application_seconds=20, charged_scheduler_seconds=34)
    platforms[platform] = item

record = {'schema': 1, 'kind': 'ownership-qualification-diagnostic-transport-failure',
          'date': '2026-10-23', 'original_freeze': {'path': 'ownership-cells-qualification-freeze-20261023.json',
            'sha256': sha(repo / 'bench/results/ownership-cells-qualification-freeze-20261023.json')},
          'platforms': platforms, 'original_failures_remain_failed': True,
          'diagnosis': 'The enlarged harness used the ordinary build helper, omitting compile definitions REPLAY_TIMING and _POSIX_C_SOURCE=200809L. The same native function returned zero, then the harness emitted inline hexadecimal columns with no native timer; the qualification parser requires binary columns.',
          'scientific_status': 'Raw return code zero; no scientific pass is claimed until independent revalidation of the preserved output.',
          'bounded_repair': {'reused_first_reference_calls_per_platform': 1, 'new_calls_per_platform': 79,
            'total_original_schedule_per_platform': 80, 'same_physical_host_required': True,
            'new_harness_same_caps': [1000000, 10000000], 'native_artifact_changes': False,
            'timer_exception': 'Only the original first reference call may use its complete-process elapsed upper bound for the diagnostic timeout. It is never a native timer or performance measurement.',
            'scientific_prerequisite': 'Exact bit conversion roundtrip, independent oracle, full fingerprint, solver signature, resource and original observation validation before new native work.',
            'original_outputs_preserved': True, 'prospective_amendment_required_before_new_calls': True},
          'independent_reviews': ['High-effort reviewer: bounded transport repair defensible if exact prefix validation, separate cohorts and charged budgets are enforced.',
                                  'Bounded Astra reviewer: existing repair authority applies; no science/timing gate waiver; native return code alone is not scientific verification.'],
          'builder_precompile_failure': {'platform': 'Darwin', 'native_calls': 0, 'binary_created': False,
            'diagnosis': 'Apple cc -MM also listed SDKSettings.json; the initial dependency assertion treated it as repository source.',
            'repair': 'Bind that explicitly permitted Apple SDK metadata separately, while binding every actual repository C/header dependency.'},
          'qualification_passed': False, 'activation_qualified': False,
          'retention_helper': {'sha256': sha(Path(__file__)), 'source': Path(__file__).read_text()}}
encoded = (json.dumps(portable(record), sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False) + '\n').encode()
assert len(encoded) < 1000000 and not any(b'/' + x in encoded for x in (b'Users/', b'projectnb/', b'home/johannes'))
with out.open('xb') as stream:
    stream.write(encoded)
print(json.dumps({'path': str(out.relative_to(repo)), 'bytes': len(encoded), 'sha256': sha(out)}))
